# Building Dwelling Thinking

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1954 · *Bauen Wohnen Denken**

A lecture given in Darmstadt in 1951, published in 1954 in *[Lectures and Essays](../works/essays-and-lectures-heidegger.md)*. [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) there conceives dwelling as the basic trait of human existence: mortals dwell by sparing the earth, the sky, the divinities and their own mortality, the fourfold.
